spec.situation_desc: couldn't pay a bill on time because the mobile app was down
spec.vuln_cue: seems confused and asks the colleague to repeat things

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Priya speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I'm Callum Ellingham. I couldn't pay my electricity bill because your app was down, and now I'm really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can look into that. First, can you give me your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that's verified. I'm sorry the app stopped you paying. I'll get the late payment charge refunded, don't worry.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: You can do that? It hasn't even been looked into yet.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm logging this as a complaint now. We'll investigate it, but the charge will be returned.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Sorry, I'm a bit confused. Can you repeat what happens next?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes, sorry. I know that's a lot to take in. I'll log the complaint, and our team will look at the app issue. If you need more time with the bill, I can put you through to our Financial Support team.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Right. And when will I hear back?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Within five working days. I'll make sure the complaints team reviews it and contacts you by Friday, 30 October.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So you're sending it to the complaints team and they'll call by Friday, and the charge is coming back?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes, that's it. I'll submit it today and the complaints team will contact you by Friday. Does that make sense?
